Criterion: Verify that flight and maintenance manuals are consistent and contain all required checklists and loading data necessary to conduct required weight and balance checks while complying with specific weight and balance requirements. Standard: Inventory checklist DD Form 365-1, Chart A and loading data contained in DD Form 365-4, Chart E (contained in TM 55-1500-342-23) is consistent as published in the operators and maintenance manuals and listed in the Weight and Balance handbook. Method of Compliance: The DD Form 365-1, Chart A and DD Form 365-4, Chart E are verified through analysis and test with actual part weighings of inventory items. The forms and manuals adhere to SAWE RP7 requirements and are delivered in accordance with DI-MGMT- 81502 (see SAWE RP7, 3.4.9). References: SAWE RP7: 3.4.9 TO 1-1B-50 NAVAIR 01-1B-50 DI-MGMT-81502 TM 55-1500-342-23

Standard: The Weight and Balance Handbook is accurate and IAW the Joint Service Technical Manual, 1-1B-50, Aircraft Weight and Balance; Sample Basic Weight Checklists (Chart A) and Loading Data (Chart E) are consistent and contain all required checklists and loading data necessary to conduct required weight and balance checks. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify Weight and Balance Handbook reflects current weight and balance information for each specific air vehicle.
(2) Verify the air vehicle is weighed and documented with DD 365-2, Form B – Aircraft Weighing Record.
(3) Verify DD 365-4, Weight and Balance Clearance Form F is used to validate the air vehicle configuration will remain within all weight and CG limits for flight. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(4) Verify flight manuals, Sample Basic Weight Checklists (DD Form 365-1, Chart A), and Loading Data (Chart E) reflect the current configuration of the air vehicle.
(5) Verify Weight and Balance Handbook reflects current weight and balance information for each specific air vehicle.
